purpose: The Azion CLI band of a product page: a horizontal section title with one outlined button, over a terminal on the pixelate texture that runs off the frame's bottom rule. The terminal is either a recorded Azion CLI session typed live by a `console-mockup` (`script`), in a fixed-height stage that rises in when it scrolls into view, or a static session whose lines enter one after another (`session`). It is a page section — the site places it from a `{ _id: 'cli-terminal-section', props }` entry and binds `props` straight onto it — and it composes `section-module`, `section-title`, `button`, `registration-frame`, `texture`, `console-mockup` and `code-block`.
useWhen: Use CliTerminalSection only on marketing pages for a full-width terminal session.
To close a product argument on how little it takes to ship from the terminal, like Functions and Workloads.
avoidWhen: For a config file or handler beside the claim → use `media-split-section` with `codeTabs`.
For several capabilities, each with its own file → use `feature-scroll-section` with code items.
related: `code-block` — the terminal session the band shows.
`media-split-section` — the sibling band with the sample (`codeTabs`) beside the copy.
bestPractices: Keep the session to a few commands and their output; comment the output lines so the copied text still runs.
Name the copy button with `copyAriaLabel` so a screen reader says what it copies.
Prefer `script` on a product page: `start` types the first-project session, `deploy` the deploy session. Use `session` for a command set the recordings do not cover.
Set `anchor` when a hero button scrolls to this band.
